station_universe: All 37 IDs and timezones in the pinned station directory, including empty stations. The 31 stations with some raw history are a coverage fact, not an error-selected subset. Source array positions are never station identities; no hourly market-index or exchange contract mapping is inferred.
chronology: Training targets and assumed label availability precede July6; calibration decisions are on/after July6 and targets plus 15-minute assumed label lag precede July20. Development decisions are on/after July20 and targets precede August17. Boundary cases whose decision precedes the required fit cutoff are retained as abstentions before any target lookup. No observation on/after August17 contributes a value.
availability: Actual source receipts occurred September6,2026 and are preserved. The 15-minute historical publication/label lag is an unverified sensitivity assumption, not a reconstructed receipt. This study is retrospective development, including pretrained-model release and training-data overlap uncertainty.
case_eligibility: Every station/calendar target/horizon is retained. Shared eligibility uses only registered timing, settled label presence, 168-hour context with >=120 finite points and latest input age <=120 minutes, and fixed support counts. Missing hours remain null; no interpolation. No error or prediction selects cases or stations. All eight candidates use the identical eligible development case IDs; any failed candidate is reported as failed without silently shrinking the panel.
calibration: For each model and horizon, use only the fixed July6-19 common calibration panel to compute additive quantile offsets on the pretrained checkpoint's fixed quantile levels. Baselines start with their point forecast repeated across levels; neural models use their own quantiles. Offsets use weatherpred.station_forecasts.quantile_offsets and outputs are monotonically rearranged. Calibration support is >=30 cases and >=7 UTC target days per horizon across eligible stations; unsupported horizons abstain for every candidate. No calibration errors tune weights, penalty, steps, support, cutoffs or architecture.
evaluation: Report all eight candidates on the shared July20-Aug16 DEVELOPMENT panel. Primary point metric: mean absolute error in Fahrenheit, first averaged within each UTC target day then equally across days. Also report root mean squared error, quantile pinball loss, central 80%/90% interval coverage and width, and station/horizon counts. Paired differences against persistence use the same cases and day grouping; no station-hours treated as independent trials. No promotion, profitability, market beating or untouched validation claim follows.
fit_policy: One fixed Chronos supervised fit through adapter.FIXED_FIT only; no RL, hyperparameter search, checkpoint choice, validation input or silent retry. Report completed steps and budget interruption explicitly; an incomplete fit cannot be relabeled as a completed 200-step candidate. Ridge penalties 1/10/100 are separate registered candidates and all are reported.
